title: Dead Zone Revive
description:
A LEGENDARY GAME FROM 2012 IS BACK!After its shutdown in 2021, Dead Zone returns fully revived!

REBUILD THE ULTIMATE SURVIVAL BASEBuild production, defensive, decorative buildings and more unlocks along the way to fortify your base against hordes of the undead and your fellow survivors alike. 

MANY CLASSES TO ASSEMBLE YOUR ULTIMATE TEAMWhat do you need? A doctor to heal you? A fast looter? A powerful fighter? A swift scout? A front-line engineer?

LEVEL UP AND GET STRONGERLevel up, equip better weapons, and increase your stats. You can be the ultimate survivor. 

THOUSANDS OF CRAFTABLE AND LOOTABLE ITEMSWeapons, gear, resources. All this with an irresistible rarity system. (No pay to win)

FORM AN ALLIANCE AND EARN REWARDSForm alliances with your friends, wage wars, complete tasks, and earn valuable rewards.
“Dead Zone Revive is a not-for-profit fan-run project, in agreement with ConArtist Games.”
description_short: Fight, rebuild, and survive in a zombie apocalypse! Lead your team in real-time missions, gather weapons, gear, and supplies, and defend your base with tactical RPG and strategy gameplay.
